assetNamePattern: Immutable autobuild-* releases carry the version-stamped asset name ffmpeg-<ffmpeg-version-string>-win64-gpl-8.1.zip; the pinned Windows asset is recorded verbatim in assetName. The matching Linux asset is ffmpeg-n8.1.3-23-g5c4f5744cd-linux64-gpl-8.1.tar.xz (see linuxAssetName).

discoveryContract.requirement: No PATH mutation is required from the shell or the installer: the backend resolver (backend/app/ffmpeg_resolution.py, contract documented in packaging/FFMPEG.md) finds the binaries staged in the runtime\ directory beside the sidecar executable via its bundled-candidate step. Prepending the installed runtime\ directory to the sidecar process's PATH remains harmless, but it is no longer required and must not be relied on as the only discovery mechanism.
discoveryContract.summary: The backend resolves each binary (ffmpeg, ffprobe) in backend/app/ffmpeg_resolution.py, first hit wins: (1) explicit environment override YTA_FFMPEG_PATH / YTA_FFPROBE_PATH (a set-but-missing override is logged at WARNING and ignored); (2) bundled candidates relative to sys.executable's directory (never CWD-relative), in order: <anchor>/runtime/<name>, <anchor>/<name>, <anchor>/../runtime/<name>, <anchor>/../../runtime/<name> (<name> is ffmpeg.exe / ffprobe.exe on Windows); (3) system PATH via shutil.which. If nothing resolves, the helpers fall back to the bare names 'ffmpeg' / 'ffprobe' so callers keep their existing binary-not-found error behaviour.

license: GPL-3.0 (BtbN --enable-gpl build of FFmpeg; FFmpeg itself is LGPL-2.1+, but this build includes GPL components such as libx264/libx265). Distribution obligations for the bundled binaries must be satisfied on the download page / release notes (docs/BUILD.md section 5 publishes hashes alongside artefacts).
pinnedBy: Round 6 freeze team (immutable pin); reconciled into this file by the Round 6 closure pass (packaging/CI fixes)
sha256Verification: VERIFIED — both hashes are recorded from the freeze team's pin, not from any aggregator: the Windows SHA-256 (sha256 / sha256Win64) is the value pinned in packaging/fetch_ffmpeg.ps1 and in the table in packaging/FFMPEG.md; the Linux SHA-256 (sha256Linux64) is the value pinned in packaging/fetch_ffmpeg.sh, the same FFMPEG.md table, and packaging/vendor/ffmpeg/VERSION.txt (written by the verified fetch). The release workflow's staging step re-verifies the downloaded Windows asset against sha256 on every run and refuses to stage on any mismatch.
sourceNotes: BtbN is the standard full-featured Windows build source for desktop/Tauri apps: static win64 GPL build including libx264/libx265 and the compile-time hardware encoders docs/BUILD.md section 6.2 requires (h264_nvenc, h264_qsv, h264_amf via libvpl/AMF). The Gyan.dev alternative was rejected for this pin: its full build ships primarily as .7z, which the release workflow's staging step cannot extract on the runner (it accepts .zip only), and its essentials build is not the full-featured build BUILD.md requires. Pinning approach: ONE upstream release is pinned by its immutable autobuild-* tag and exact asset URL, and verified by SHA-256 before staging; the hash is part of the pin, never advisory. BtbN publishes a checksums.sha256 asset alongside every release (see checksumsUrl); any future FFmpeg bump is a deliberate edit of this file in code review, with the new hashes taken from the new release's checksums.sha256 and the fetch scripts the same way.

staging.notes: Matches .github/workflows/release.yml step 'Stage pinned FFmpeg (packaging/ffmpeg-pin.json)': download 'url', verify SHA-256 against 'sha256', extract the .zip, copy ffmpeg.exe + ffprobe.exe to src-tauri/binaries/ffmpeg/, from where the Tauri bundler resources place them in the installed app's runtime\ folder (docs/BUILD.md section 3 disk layout; section 6.2: FFmpeg versions with the backend package because the sidecar is its only caller). The backend resolver finds them there via its bundled runtime\ candidate (see discoveryContract) — no PATH prepend is required. Version + hash are recorded in the build manifest / backend.json ffmpegVersion per docs/BUILD.md sections 6.2 and 9.

verifyAndFillOnFirstCiRun: FILLED — this protocol no longer applies. The pin was resolved from the floating 'latest' form to the immutable autobuild-2026-10-22-13-06 release by the freeze team (packaging/fetch_ffmpeg.sh, packaging/fetch_ffmpeg.ps1, packaging/FFMPEG.md) and reconciled into this file in the Round 6 closure pass: releaseTag, url, assetName, version and both platform SHA-256 hashes are now real recorded values. The release workflow's staging step therefore passes its non-empty-SHA-256 gate and verifies the downloaded asset against sha256 on every run; it still refuses to stage on an empty hash or any mismatch.
versionNotes: Immutable pin: version n8.1.3-23-g5c4f5744cd (FFmpeg 8.1 release branch) from BtbN release tag autobuild-2026-10-22-13-06. This replaces the previous floating form ('latest' release tag, version 'master-latest', sha256 null), which named a moving master snapshot and could never be shipped. Never re-float this pin: a version change is a deliberate, reviewed edit of releaseTag/url/assetName/version/sha256 together.
